title: Administrator-only provider verification workflow (documents + Verify button)

requirements.text: Implement backend endpoints for a provider verification workflow where service providers can submit required verification documents and the Administrator can review a provider’s full profile and set the provider’s verification status via a single “Verify” action.

quotes: the administrator has the sole responsibility of going through the service providers profile and if everything is okey. the admin can hit verify button

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes authenticated provider-facing methods to upload/submit required verification documents (at minimum: academic qualification(s) and certificate of good conduct) and transitions the provider verificationStatus to Pending when a submission is made.
Backend exposes Administrator-only methods to (a) list providers requiring review and (b) fetch a provider’s profile details including submitted documents and current verificationStatus.
Backend exposes an Administrator-only method to mark a provider as Verified (and optionally Rejected with a reason), updating the provider’s verificationStatus accordingly.
Non-admin callers are rejected when attempting to access admin-only verification review/verification methods.

requirements.text: Replace the placeholder “Verification Review” admin page with a functional Administrator verification review UI that allows the Administrator to browse providers, open a provider’s profile for review (identity + service info + uploaded verification documents + current status), and click a “Verify” button to mark the provider as Verified.

quotes: the administrator has the sole responsibility of going through the service providers profile and if everything is okey. the admin can hit verify button

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/pages/backoffice/VerificationReviewPage.tsx no longer shows a “future update” placeholder and instead renders a working review experience for admins.
The page is access-controlled using the existing admin check (useIsCallerAdmin) and shows a clear access denied state for non-admins.
The Administrator can select a provider, view their profile fields, see current verification status, and click “Verify” to set status to Verified; the UI refreshes to show the updated status.
Verification actions show loading/progress state and success/error feedback.

requirements.text: Replace the placeholder provider “Verification Status / Document Upload” page with a working document upload & submission UI for providers, including status display (Unverified / Pending / Verified / Rejected) and a submission action that sends the required documents for Administrator review.

quotes: You want a new section where service providers can upload their required documents, and these documents should be viewed and approved by the Administrator (not “technical team”).
the administrator has the sole responsibility of going through the service providers profile and if everything is okey. the admin can hit verify button

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/pages/provider/VerificationUploadPage.tsx provides file upload inputs for the required document types (academic qualifications and certificate of good conduct) and a submission control to send them for review.
After submission, the provider’s verificationStatus becomes Pending and the UI reflects the updated state via refetch.
If verificationStatus is Rejected, the rejection reason is displayed to the provider.
All user-facing strings in this flow refer to “Administrator” (not “technical team”).

requirements.text: Update all user-facing terminology in the verification-related UI to use “Administrator” instead of “technical team”, including admin-only tooling panels that are currently labeled “Technical Team Tools”.

quotes: and these documents should be viewed and approved by the Administrator (not “technical team”).

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/pages/backoffice/ProviderDatasetToolsPanel.tsx headings/descriptions replace “Technical Team Tools” with “Administrator Tools” (or equivalent) while preserving meaning.
No remaining visible UI copy in verification/admin review areas refers to “technical team”.

requirements.text: Add React Query hooks and UI wiring needed to call the new backend verification/document endpoints, ensuring relevant queries are invalidated so status changes appear without a full reload.

quotes: the admin can hit verify button

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts (or a new non-immutable hooks file) includes mutations/queries for provider document submission and admin verification actions.
After successful mutations, the app invalidates/refetches at least ['currentUserProfile'] and any provider/admin review lists so updated verificationStatus is visible immediately.
Non-admin errors from admin endpoints are surfaced to the UI in a user-readable way.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Only generate backend/migration.mo if adding/changing stable state in a way that requires an upgrade migration; avoid migrations if only adding methods that use existing stored fields.
Do not edit files in frontend immutablePaths (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*).
Use English for all user-facing UI text.
nonGoals: Adding real-time notifications for verification status changes.
Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Implementing external database storage or off-chain file storage beyond the existing IC/blob storage approach.
Building a separate “technical team” role; verification authority is the Administrator only.
